item.title: Karoline Leavitt demands retraction of ABC News story claiming FBI warned Iran could attack California
item.summary: Karoline Leavitt blasts ABC News for Iran drone attack story, saying no such threat exists and the network alarmed Americans with misleading framing about California attacks.

item.title: Trump warns of Iranian 'sleeper cells' as Canada is accused of harboring regime operatives
item.summary: Canadian Conservatives slam Liberal government for allegedly allowing hundreds of Iranian regime officials to remain despite known security risks.

item.title: Trump says Iran’s World Cup participation may not be ‘appropriate,’ while adding men’s team is still ‘welcome’
item.summary: President Donald Trump said Iran's national soccer team is "welcome" to play in the World Cup, but cautioned it might not be "appropriate" to compete amid the ongoing conflict.

item.title: NYC boosts patrols amid ‘heightened threat environment,' after gunman rams truck into Michigan synagogue
item.summary: New York City ramps up security as an attack was reported at a Michigan synagogue, leaving a security guard unconscious. Officials condemned 'horrifying' antisemitic violence.

item.title: Unexplained loud bangs perplex neighbors near homes of alleged NYC terror plot suspects
item.summary: Mysterious explosions plagued Bucks County for months near homes of men now accused in alleged ISIS-inspired NYC terror plot. Police found no evidence, Fox News Digital confirmed.

item.title: Airports set up donation drives for unpaid TSA officers during DHS funding crisis
item.summary: Airports nationwide launch donation drives to support TSA officers working without pay during government funding lapse, with gift cards and food pantries.

item.title: Old Dominion University shooter identified as Mohamed Jalloh, former National Guard member, ISIS supporter
item.summary: Suspected Old Dominion University shooter identified as former National Guard soldier convicted of supporting ISIS. Mohamed Bailor Jalloh served 11 years in prison.

item.title: Democrat state lawmaker debates former NCAA volleyball player who forfeited to SJSU team with trans athlete
item.summary: Arizona senator Catherine Miranda faces backlash after questioning volleyball activist's competitiveness during heated transgender sports bill hearing.

item.title: Marine veteran Joey Jones rips critics for attacking troops over steak and lobster meals
item.summary: Fox News co-host Joey Jones defends military steak and lobster spending, saying rare surf and turf nights boost morale during tough deployments overseas.

item.title: FBI held active shooter training at Michigan synagogue weeks before attack
item.summary: Michigan synagogue with FBI training targeted by armed attacker who police say rammed vehicle inside building, died in shootout with security.
